title: paraxial.first-order data
description: The first-order data of a system, one value per line of the case: every array is float64 of shape [L]. Positions are z in the contract frame, mm. Code checks that the arrays have one length.

efl.description: The effective focal length: the rear focal point minus the rear principal point.

backFocus.description: The rear focal point minus the vertex of the last lens surface.

entrancePupilZ.description: The paraxial image of the stop in object space.

exitPupilZ.description: The paraxial image of the stop in image space.

entrancePupilSemiDiameter.description: The radius of the paraxial image of the stop in object space, from the stop's radius.

exitPupilSemiDiameter.description: The radius of the paraxial image of the stop in image space, from the stop's radius.

recorded.description: Values of the engine's own, by name, one per line: reported and never judged.
